name: Hotel Belmar

transfer_minutes.label: Approximately 153-195 minutes (137 km) by private transfer from Juan Santamaria International Airport (SJO), based on real driving distance.

description: A family-owned boutique hotel and 40-year flagship of the Monteverde region, Hotel Belmar blends alpine architecture with Costa Rican flair overlooking the cloud forest. A member of Design Hotels, it emphasizes regenerative sustainability, immersive nature experiences, and elevated farm-to-table cuisine.
hero_description: A conscious-private cloud forest retreat where alpine charm meets Costa Rican nature.
local_insight: Belmar is ideal for mindful travelers who want eco-adventure and wellness without sacrificing style or great food. Its on-site brewery, forest immersions, and farm experiences make it a standout base for exploring Monteverde.

faq.q: How far is Hotel Belmar from the airport?
faq.a: Hotel Belmar is approximately 153-195 minutes (137 km) by private transfer from Juan Santamaria International Airport (SJO), based on real driving distance -- Monteverde is a mountain destination, so plan for a half-day journey either way.

faq.q: What makes Hotel Belmar different from other Monteverde hotels?
faq.a: Hotel Belmar is a family-owned boutique hotel and 40-year flagship of the Monteverde region, and a member of Design Hotels. It combines alpine-inspired architecture overlooking the cloud forest with its own on-site farm, craft microbrewery, and farm-to-table restaurant -- amenities most other Monteverde properties do not have.

faq.q: Who is Hotel Belmar best suited for?
faq.a: Belmar suits mindful travelers who want eco-adventure and wellness without sacrificing style or great food. Its on-site brewery, forest immersions through the SAVIA program, and farm experiences make it a strong base for exploring Monteverde.

amenities: Spring water pond and soaking jet pool

traveler_profile_reasons.reason: Its regenerative sustainability ethos, green operations, and forest immersions at SAVIA appeal to those who prioritize responsible travel.
Restaurante Celajes, the Cervecería Belmar microbrewery, and cocktail and coffee tasting classes make it a haven for culinary-minded guests.
Yoga, massage therapy, a soaking jet pool, and nature-centered experiences support travelers embracing holistic wellness.
